title: Time to NARROW your job search 🔎
description:
Finding your next role can be challenging, but setting goals and intentions for your job search will save you time and stress. Before you start working on your resume or applying for jobs, make sure you've got goals set. This will help align roles that best fit you and give you a reminder of your goals while you search. #career #careeradvice #careertok #careergrowth
